{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Inspect the data structure
df_info = trial_df.info()
print(df_info)

# Check for missing values
missing_values = trial_df.isnull().sum()
print("\nMissing values:\")
print(missing_values)

# Check for duplicates
duplicates = trial_df.duplicated().sum()
print(f"\nNumber of duplicate rows: {duplicates}")

# Display unique values in the 'site' column
unique_sites = trial_df['site'].unique()
print(f"\nUnique sites: {unique_sites}")

# Display the first few rows of the data to inspect the response variable
trial_df.head()"}
